sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete source geometry and native finite-feasibility outcomes retained privately. Only display coordinates are projected. No optimality, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, human oversight or unconfirmed contact-count claim. Drawing admission does not assign the imported result's confirmation rung.
